fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6% of total Gross Sales plus a surcharge of up to $10/week; for Pinkberry Vending Machines, royalty is $200/month flat. Advertising Fee is up to 4% of Gross Sales; currently charged at 2% of monthly Gross Sales; for Vending Machines, $50/month flat. Franchisor may increase Advertising Fee up to 4% cap with 30 days notice. In breach/default, royalties may be increased to up to 18% of Gross Sales or 3x the fixed royalty fee. Management Fee of 6% of Gross Sales (in addition to Royalty and Advertising Fees) applies if franchisor assumes management. Loyalty Program fee up to $160/month per location. Online Ordering Program $60/month. Brink Par Tech Systems $85-$200/month. Data Fees up to $75/month. POS System Annual Warranty Service $1,000-$2,000/year.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee and Surcharge (Note 1): 6% of total Gross Sales. Surcharge is a maximum of $10 per week in addition to the Royalty Fee. For Non-Traditional Restaurants that are Pinkberry Vending Machines, $200 per month. Withdrawn electronically from your Depository Account on the 10th day of each calendar month (Note 3).

Advertising Fees (Note 1): Up to 4% of Gross Sales. For Non-Traditional Restaurants that are Pinkberry Vending Machines, $50 per month. Same as Royalty Fee (Note 3). Currently, Advertising Fee is 2% of monthly Gross Sales. (Note 7)

Pinkberry Loyalty Program: Up to $160 per month per location.

Online Ordering Program: $60 per month.

Brink Par Tech Systems: $85 to $200 per month based upon number of terminals/troubleshooting package.

Data Fees (Note 5): Up to $75 per month.

Management Fee: 6% of the Franchised Business' Gross Sales (in addition to the Royalty Fee and Advertising Fee) plus our direct out-of-pocket costs and expenses.
